raw: SELECT T2.zone FROM trips AS T1 JOIN zones AS T2 ON T1.do_location_id = T2.location_id WHERE T2.zone = 'JFK Airport' GROUP BY T2.zone ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
sql: SELECT T2.zone FROM trips AS T1 JOIN zones AS T2 ON T1.do_location_id = T2.location_id WHERE T2.zone = 'JFK Airport' GROUP BY T2.zone ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

raw: SELECT t2.zone, SUM(t.tip_amount) FROM trips t JOIN zones t2 ON t.pu_location_id = t2.location_id WHERE t2.borough = 'Brooklyn' GROUP BY t2.zone ORDER BY SUM(t.tip_amount) DESC LIMIT 3
sql: SELECT t2.zone, SUM(t.tip_amount) FROM trips t JOIN zones t2 ON t.pu_location_id = t2.location_id WHERE t2.borough = 'Brooklyn' GROUP BY t2.zone ORDER BY SUM(t.tip_amount) DESC LIMIT 3

raw: SELECT CAST(strftime('%H', t.pickup_datetime) AS INTEGER) AS hour, COUNT(*) AS num_trips FROM trips t GROUP BY hour ORDER BY num_trips DESC LIMIT 1
sql: SELECT CAST(strftime('%H', t.pickup_datetime) AS INTEGER) AS hour, COUNT(*) AS num_trips FROM trips t GROUP BY hour ORDER BY num_trips DESC LIMIT 1

raw: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trips WHERE tip_amount > fare_amount
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trips WHERE tip_amount > fare_amount

raw: SELECT AVG(t.total_amount) FROM trips t JOIN zones pz ON t.pu_location_id = pz.location_id WHERE pz.borough = 'Queens' AND t.payment_type = ( SELECT payment_type_id FROM payment_types WHERE name = 'Cash' ) AND t.pu_location_id = t.do_location_id
sql: SELECT AVG(t.total_amount) FROM trips t JOIN zones pz ON t.pu_location_id = pz.location_id WHERE pz.borough = 'Queens' AND t.payment_type = ( SELECT payment_type_id FROM payment_types WHERE name = 'Cash' ) AND t.pu_location_id = t.do_location_id

raw: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zones pz JOIN trips t ON pz.location_id = t.pu_location_id WHERE pz.borough = 'Manhattan' GROUP BY pz.location_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000 )
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zones pz JOIN trips t ON pz.location_id = t.pu_location_id WHERE pz.borough = 'Manhattan' GROUP BY pz.location_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000 )

raw: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t.do_location_id IN ( SELECT location_id FROM zones WHERE service_zone IN ('JFK Airport', 'LaGuardia Airport', 'Newark Airport') ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM trips t WHERE t.trip_distance > 20
sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t.do_location_id IN ( SELECT location_id FROM zones WHERE service_zone IN ('JFK Airport', 'LaGuardia Airport', 'Newark Airport') ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM trips t WHERE t.trip_distance > 20
